_comment: ZBrush corpus registry (TEMPLATE). Real ZBrush files are referenced by ABSOLUTE PATH, never copied into the repo (docs/formats/zbrush/LEGAL.md section 5). Keep your own entries in a private copy of this file and point OXY_ZTL_CORPUS at it; do not commit private paths. Entries whose path does not exist are skipped.
_format_note: Each entry: { tag, path, file_type (ztl|zpr), zbrush_version, license_status (synthetic|owner), notes }. 'synthetic' files are trivially simple files created from scratch and dedicated CC0; only those may be committed, each with a .gitignore negation. CI (scripts/check_corpus_ip.py) fails the build otherwise.

files.notes: EXAMPLE entry. Replace (in your private copy) with a local absolute path to one of YOUR OWN ZBrush files. Skipped when the path does not exist.
